title: Enterprise user hard-stop boundary
summary: Reach Alice's user-level budget exactly in the Enterprise tenant, then demonstrate atomic rejection of the next event.

steps.title: Start using credits
steps.description: A week into the billing period Alice consumes her first 300 AI credits, worth $3.
steps.expected: The event is accepted and Alice's ULB reaches 30% with $7 of headroom.

steps.title: Keep working through mid-month
steps.expected: The event is accepted and Alice's ULB reaches 55% without an alert.

steps.title: Cross the warning threshold
steps.description: A further 200 credits, worth $2, push Alice past the warning threshold.
steps.expected: The event is accepted, the ULB reaches exactly 75%, and its 75% alert fires.

steps.title: Reach the exact limit
steps.description: Alice consumes the last 250 AI credits, worth $2.50, bringing her total to $10.
steps.expected: The event is accepted and Alice's ULB reaches exactly 100%.

steps.title: Attempt the next event
steps.description: Alice attempts to consume one additional AI credit.
steps.expected: The complete event is rejected by Alice's user-level hard stop and no counter changes.
